name: record-jukebox
comment: WP-2.6. ItemRecord.onItemUse with BlockJukeBox (use_item: sendPlaceBlock calls the jukebox's blockActivated first). Stone platform y 60, a jukebox at (2, 61, 2); the player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) holds record 13 (hotbar 0, id 2256) and the cat record (hotbar 1, id 2257). t 2: blockActivated of the empty jukebox (metadata 0) is false, so ItemRecord.onItemUse inserts the record (BlockJukeBox.ejectRecord, MCP's name for the insert: metadata 1, aux effect 1005) and the emptied stack leaves the slot. t 5: with the cat record, blockActivated ejects record 13 (an EntityItem with World.rand offsets) and returns true, so the item is not used. t 8: the cat record goes in (on a side face). t 11: an empty hand ejects it. The ejected records fall near the player, who picks them up. t 30: an empty hand on stone does nothing.
